sources.summary: At Casa Damata, located in the rural area of Itatiba (SP), the interior design by Melina Romano builds upon Otto Felix's architecture and Daniel Nunes's landscaping to reinforce the relationship between the residence and its surrounding landscape. The design extends the materiality and construction references of the rural São Paulo context indoors, coordinating materials, furniture, lighting, and artwork into a continuous language between interior and exterior.
